session.assistantText:
Waiting for the subagent to finish.
No fallback was needed. The probe ran on a real non-default route.

**Route used.** `magpie/workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash` with effort `low`. This is the route the pstack role `feature, refactoring` already maps to, and it is a different vendor and a different model family from the parent chat model, `magpie/workbuddy/minimax-m3.1-flash`.

**How I picked it.** `pstack_models` advertised four routes. Two sit under `deepseek-account` (`deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro`), and the current role config only lists `magpie` routes, so the `magpie/workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash` entry is the closest match for a non-Claude-style vendor swap under the existing role routing.

**Evidence the route is live.** The subagent ran `pwd` and `ls -la` and read `README.md` with the read tool. It reported the working directory as `<TEMP_PATH> found `README.md` alongside `.git`, and reproduced the file's three lines including the Chinese text `能力探测。`. It created, edited, and deleted nothing, and ran no git commands.

**What a maintainer inherits.** The workspace itself is unchanged. `README.md` is still untracked in git, and the repo has no commits on any branch yet. If you want this probe recorded rather than left as a live run, say so and I will commit the README as the seed commit.
